## R-AIRSPEED

**Airspeed sensor placement and accuracy** — The pitot sits outside the prop slipstream in cruise (>= 1 prop radius laterally clear of every disc edge, or ahead of the prop plane; B4's wash-error bound CL-B4-PITOT <= 2 % is the working form), and the airspeed error at cruise (16 m/s), taken as the root-sum-square of the error budget (sensor, prop wash, calibration residual, resolution) after ARSPD_AUTOCAL and reciprocal legs, is <= 0.5 m/s (D-37: the margin from cruise down to 1.3 Vs is 0.49-0.58 m/s); in flight, the mean of |ARSPD - GPS-derived true airspeed| over a four-leg reciprocal box in calm air is within that limit — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/config-study/tiebreak/DECISION.md#5.1

## R-FAILSAFES

**Failsafes and geofence** — RC loss -> QLAND or QRTL; GCS loss (if telemetry is used) -> as configured; battery low -> return, critical -> land; Q_TRANS_FAIL -> QRTL; geofence = the RFS sub-field polygon plus the 400 ft ceiling with a fence action; each action is demonstrated in SITL and on the bench (props off, transmitter switched off, voltage simulated) before the first flight — **UNVERIFIED**

## R-GUST-LEAN

**8 m/s gust survive-and-land** — The hover attitude needed to hold position in an 8 m/s gust (flat-plate method, wing broadside) is <= Q_A_ANGLE_MAX minus 5 deg (F4 sets Q_A_ANGLE_MAX accordingly), and the thrust needed at that lean (W / cos lean) leaves a thrust headroom >= 1.3 at the gate mass with voltage sag — **UNVERIFIED**

## R-HOVER-AUTHORITY

**Hover control authority** — At the gate mass in hover, motor-differential control gives an angular acceleration on each body axis >= 2 rad/s2 and >= 1.5 x the acceleration the 5 m/s wind moment demands, using <= 30 % of hover thrust per motor as differential after the pitch-trim split (R-HOVER-SPLIT); the 30 % cap applies on every axis, yaw included (CR-B3-16: D-27 raised the cant to 7 deg rather than lift the cap); yaw (about the hover vertical, from the 7 deg tangential cant plus prop reaction torque) is the axis to show — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/config-study/REQUIREMENTS-PROPOSED.md#P8

## R-LANDING-IMPACT

**Fin-tip landing** — The four replaceable constant-force feet absorb a vertical landing at 1.5 m/s sink (3 x the 0.5 m/s Q_LAND_SPEED default) with 2/3 W of lift still on, at any touchdown tilt <= 10 deg in pitch or roll (level, pad-pair first, one fin's pair first), with airframe load factor <= 6 and >= 3 mm of the usable stroke left (foot stroke >= 0.038 m, C5's 3 mm guard), no damage beyond the feet; shown by C5's planar landing model validated by T-C5-AIRCRAFT-DROP; a foot is replaced in <= 10 min in the field (snap-fit piston, no adhesive) — **UNVERIFIED** **FAILS**

**Pilot readiness** — The designated pilot logs >= 10 h of ArduPilot SITL on the tailsitter model with the team's parameter file, including QSTABILIZE recovery from a failed transition, plus stick time on the foam-board twin or a small quad, before the first XPS hover — **UNVERIFIED**

## R-PROCESS

**Build processes** — Every part in every parts.csv is bought or made by one of: hot-wire XPS from printed templates, packing-tape skin, knife- or laser-cut foam board, FDM PETG or PLA, epoxy or CA bonds, standard fasteners, hand-cut CF tube; no composite lay-up, no machining beyond drilling; printed parts <= 0.2 m on any axis — **UNVERIFIED**

## R-RC-LINK

**RC link and telemetry** — The ELRS ground range check at 25 mW (the RadioMaster Pocket's lowest setting; 10 mW is not offered) passes at 100 m with LQ >= 0.9, no failsafe, and the better of 1RSS/2RSS >= -93.8 dBm in every position (the RSSI line that proves >= 10 dB of fade margin at the 500 m VLOS limit at 100 mW); in flight, link quality stays >= 0.9 and RSSI >= -102 dBm in the logs out to the geofence radius (CL-F4-FENCE-RADIUS, half the VLOS limit), and the 500 m case at 400 ft is covered by analysis (CL-F5-LINK-MARGIN); RSSI/LQ and telemetry are logged — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/TEAM.md#F5

## R-TEST-ORDER

**Test gates in order** — Gates passed and logged in order, none skipped: (1) twin (R-TWIN); (2) thrust stand, one station (R-HOVER-TW); (3) XPS aircraft weigh-in (R-MASS-GATE) and tethered hover with current within +/-0.15 x 27 A of that value and the limiter verified (R-ESC-CURRENT); (4) untethered QHOVER/QLOITER; (5) fixed-wing tune as a plain flying wing; (6) first transition at >= 50 m AGL with QSTABILIZE recovery rehearsed; (7) back-transition at altitude; (8) landing practice in calm air; (9) full mission (R-MISSION). H3 gives go/no-go on the 5 m/s flight card — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/config-study/tiebreak/DECISION.md#5.4

## R-TWIN

**Foam-board twin gate** — The foam-board twin on the real motors, FC and pack holds position within 1 m in calm air and in a 5 m/s fan or breeze with logged lean <= 20 deg; flies QLOITER at >= 30 m; completes a transition at >= 1.3 Vs, two laps and a back-transition; hover current within +/-0.15 x 27 A of that value and cruise near 14.7 A; the elevon size that gives clean FBWA authority is recorded. A wind fail triggers the K11 planform test, then the K01 fallback (CONFIGURATION.md) — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/config-study/tiebreak/DECISION.md#8


## R-VIBRATION

**Rotor-excited vibration** — (a) Fin stations: the first bending and torsion natural frequencies of each motor tube + through-core block + half-fins + mount assembly with motors fitted lie outside +/-0.2 of 1P at hover rpm and of 2P (blade pass) at hover and cruise rpm; the operating points are the criterion of record and B4's 80-330 Hz whole-band rule is advisory (CR-C4-06); C4's CL-C4-D3-SEP on the two-layer fin (D-26) supersedes CL-J1-TUBE-MODE-SEP. (b) Wing modes: the station-participating wing modes (antisymmetric torsion 12-15 Hz, in-plane ~215 Hz) cannot clear the same windows with any spar from 16 to 25 mm (CL-C2-WING-MODE-SEP, D-45), so they are closed by the tap-test branch: the tap test of the finished wing with motors fitted (T-C2-TAP-TEST) shows each such mode either damped or inside the rpm-tracking harmonic notch (F4 INS_HNTCH_* on ESC rpm, CL-F4-NOTCH-LOW, covering 1P and 2P over the rpm range), the rate-loop crossover stays <= 5 Hz, and B3 carries the 12-15 Hz antisymmetric torsion mode in the hover loop model. (c) The flight-controller vibration (ArduPilot VIBE) stays < 30 m/s2 in hover with Clip = 0 — **UNVERIFIED** **FAILS**  
Defined in: redesign/params/CHANGE-LOG.md#D-45
